STS2ARIS-CHARGE.title: Charge
STS2ARIS-CHARGE.description: If you lack Energy, you can spend Charge to play cards. Charge disappears at the end of your turn.
STS2ARIS-SHOCK.title: Shock
STS2ARIS-SHOCK.description: Whenever you are attacked, lose HP equal to your Shock and reduce Shock by 1.
STS2ARIS-OVERLOAD.title: Overload
STS2ARIS-OVERLOAD.description: This effect activates if your remaining Energy is 0 after this card is played.
STS2ARIS-OUTPUT.title: Output
STS2ARIS-OUTPUT.description: Charge cannot be spent to play this card.
STS2ARIS-EQUIPMENT.title: Equipment
STS2ARIS-EQUIPMENT.description: When played, this attaches to the character and changes Jobs. If you already have Equipment, discard the old Equipment.
STS2ARIS-CLASSCHANGE.title: Class Change
STS2ARIS-CLASSCHANGE.description: This effect triggers when your Job changes.
STS2ARIS-JOB.title: Job
STS2ARIS-JOB.description: Your Job effect applies while Equipment is equipped. You can only have one Job at a time.
STS2ARIS-REWARD.title: Reward
STS2ARIS-REWARD.description: Reward cards cannot be obtained normally. You can get them by completing Quests.
STS2ARIS-QUEST.title: Quest
STS2ARIS-QUEST.description: When you complete a Quest, it turns into a Reward card.
